description: A first AR/VR training lesson for K-12 learners: meet the safety station, learn to measure, identify tools, and follow a procedure in order. Fundamentals tier. Simulation only — not certification and not a school credential.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Trade halls in the Holodeck player (per vr-entry README): Ironworkers, Welding Trades, Boilermakers, Millwrights. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4).

sources: SmartCiti.X skill registry strand names (pack/registry/skills.json, via vr-entry README): coordination, documentation, inspection, layout, leadership, machines, materials, procedure, safety, tools, troubleshooting.
OSHA PPE topic page (osha.gov/personal-protective-equipment): PPE training points (when necessary, what kind, fit, limitations, care).

stations.title: Safety station — PPE, first aid, extinguisher

steps.action: PPE check: pick the right gear for the job and check the fit.
steps.check: PPE fits; learner can name when it is necessary.

steps.action: Measure a length twice and mark it before cutting anything.
Identify three tools on the wall and say what each one does.
steps.check: Three tools named with their jobs.

steps.action: Follow the printed procedure in order — no skipped steps.
Tidy the bench, return every tool, and debrief with the coach.

title: K-12 AR/VR foundations — measure, tools, safety
